author: jdthomas24
releaseNotes: v1.0.0 (beta): Native local Apple TV control. Bonjour discovery, one-time PIN pairing, Switch on (wake) and off (standby), live power state, automatic reconnect. No bridge or extra hardware.

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. Switch on wakes it, off puts it to sleep, with live power state over an encrypted local connection.
